map.由两组样本量方差求合并方差 使用指南: Pooled Variance from Two Sample Variances User Guide
map.输入两组样本量n₁、n₂及其方差s₁²、s₂²，按加权平均求合并方差s_p²，用: Enter the two sample sizes n1 and n2 with their variances s1^2 and s2^2 and compute the pooled variance s_p^2 as a weighted average, used for the variance equality step before a two-independent-sample t test, which suits statistical inference on experimental data.
map.两样本 t 检验的共同方差估计。: The common variance estimate for a two-sample t test.
map.假设方差齐时更精确。: More precise when variances are assumed equal.
map.由事件概率求其补事件概率: Complement event probability from an event probability
map.合并方差为何加权平均？: Why Is the Pooled Variance a Weighted Average?
map.用自由度（n−1）加权，样本多的组方差权重更大，是无偏合并。: Weight by degrees of freedom (n-1), so the group with more samples has greater weight on the variance, giving an unbiased pooled value.
map.方差不齐还能合并？: Can Variances Still Be Pooled When Unequal?
map.不宜，应直接用 Welch t（不合并、df 校正）。: Not appropriate; use Welch's t directly (no pooling, with df correction).
